headline: Obama order freezes the US property of certain transnational criminal organizations.
what_it_does: This executive order blocks, or freezes, property and assets in the United States that belong to certain transnational criminal organizations. These are crime groups that operate across national borders. Orders like this usually also bar people and businesses in the US from doing business with the targeted groups. The title alone does not list the specific groups or details.

who_it_affects.group: Transnational criminal organizations and people tied to them
who_it_affects.how: Their property and assets under US control can be frozen.
They may have to freeze covered assets and avoid deals with the targeted groups.
